# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi

"""Make a separate model-comparison controller after the user's criterion correction."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
SOURCE = B / 'main-long-decode128-controller-source-v2'
DEST = B / 'main-long-decode128-controller-source-v3'


def replace_once(text, old, new):
    assert text.count(old) == 1, old
    return text.replace(old, new, 1)


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    assert not DEST.exists()
    DEST.mkdir()
    source = (SOURCE / 'worker-long-decode-v2.py.txt').read_text()
    source = replace_once(source, "CLEAN_PARENT = B / 'main-long-decode128-root-v2'",
                          "CLEAN_PARENT = B / 'main-long-decode128-root-v3'")
    source = replace_once(source, "worker-long-decode-cpu-fixtures-v2.py.txt",
                          "worker-long-decode-cpu-fixtures-v3.py.txt")
    source = replace_once(source,
        "    require(long.get('main_reviewed') is True and long.get('status') == 'passed', 'new long campaign review')",
        "    require(long.get('main_reviewed') is True and long.get('status') == 'passed', 'new long campaign review')\n"
        "    require(long.get('comparison_policy') == 'measure_outputs_quality_separate',\n"
        "            'explicit Main policy: generated output differences are observations, not model-quality failures')")
    source = replace_once(source,
        "                require(r['first16_comparison']['passed'], 'actual first16 equality to fixed and admitted baseline')",
        "                r['first16_comparison']['scope'] += '; difference retained, not a model-quality verdict'")
    source = replace_once(source,
        "                require(equal, 'all workers/optionalGU arms preserve newly observed full128 output fingerprint')",
        "                r['long_output_reference']['scope'] += '; histories may differ after first token divergence'")
    source = replace_once(source,
        "                    require(equal, 'optional pairedGU full128 token/LP5 equality')",
        "                    r['paired_gu_comparison']['scope'] += '; no quality verdict from generation equality'")
    source = replace_once(source,
        "                 performance_eligible=False, full_context_runtime_qualified=False, restore_qualified=False,",
        "                 performance_eligible=False, full_context_runtime_qualified=False, restore_qualified=False,\n"
        "                 quality_evaluated=False, quality_qualified=False,\n"
        "                 comparison_policy=q['long_decode128']['comparison_policy'],")
    source = replace_once(source,
        "                equal = decision['passed']\n                r['long_output_reference']",
        "                r['long_output_reference']")
    source = replace_once(source,
        "                    equal = decision['passed']\n                    r['paired_gu_comparison']",
        "                    r['paired_gu_comparison']")
    source = replace_once(source,
        "            r['scope'] = '128 reported tokens/LP5; actual first16 prefix match only. No full-vocab quality/64K/256K/optimal-speed claim.'",
        "            r['scope'] = ('128 output/LP5 observations; exact equality recorded separately from runtime completion. '\n"
        "                          'Different output histories can change decode work. No full-vocab quality/64K/256K qualification.')")
    (DEST / 'worker-long-decode-v3.py.txt').write_text(source)
    fixture = (SOURCE / 'worker-long-decode-cpu-fixtures-v2.py.txt').read_text()
    fixture = replace_once(fixture, 'worker-long-decode-v2.py.txt', 'worker-long-decode-v3.py.txt')
    fixture = replace_once(fixture,
        "    return dict(long_decode128=dict(main_reviewed=True, status='passed', generated_tokens=128,",
        "    return dict(long_decode128=dict(main_reviewed=True, status='passed', generated_tokens=128,\n"
        "        comparison_policy='measure_outputs_quality_separate',")
    fixture = replace_once(fixture,
        "        bad = admission(); bad['long_decode128']['status'] = 'PENDING'",
        "        policy = admission(); policy['long_decode128']['comparison_policy'] = 'reject_any_output_difference'\n"
        "        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):\n"
        "            module.long_plan(policy, 1, 3, 'unchanged')\n"
        "        bad = admission(); bad['long_decode128']['status'] = 'PENDING'")
    (DEST / 'worker-long-decode-cpu-fixtures-v3.py.txt').write_text(fixture)
    extension = json.loads((SOURCE / 'qualification-extension.pending.json').read_text())
    long = extension['long_decode128']
    long['namespace'] = str(B / 'main-long-decode128-root-v3')
    long['comparison_policy'] = 'measure_outputs_quality_separate'
    long['source_pins'] = {str(DEST / n): hashlib.sha256((DEST / n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                           for n in ['worker-long-decode-v3.py.txt', 'worker-long-decode-cpu-fixtures-v3.py.txt']}
    (DEST / 'qualification-extension.pending.json').write_text(json.dumps(extension, indent=2) + '\n')
    (DEST / 'POLICY.txt').write_text(
        'Main derivative of immutable SourceOnly v2, following the user correction on 2026-10-13.\n'
        'Finite/protocol/context/runtime/fault/ownership/QUIT gates are unchanged.\n'
        'Generation fingerprint differences remain measured observations, never proof of model quality loss.\n'
        'A closed fault-free run may be speed-measurement eligible while quality remains unevaluated/unqualified.\n'
        'Same-input histories/full-vocabulary comparison and task scores are required for quality evaluation.\n'
        'Strict bitwise CPU arithmetic fixtures remain valid and are not weakened.\n'
        'Old v2 artifacts/results are immutable. This new source needs fresh Main CPU/admission qualification.\n')
    print(json.dumps(long['source_pins']))
